zh-CN.title: 个性化改为分级开放
items: 聊天背景不再统一要求 LV8，基础背景、气泡与头像框现在直接可用
更多个性化主题会随 LV4 至 LV12 逐步解锁，自定义上传背景保留 LV8
Niko 与 Fufu 主题需要永久 VIP 或达到 LV16

en.title: Tiered personalization access
items: Chat backgrounds no longer require LV8 as a whole; basic backgrounds, bubbles, and frames are free
More themes unlock progressively from LV4 to LV12, while custom background uploads remain at LV8
Niko and Fufu themes require Lifetime VIP or LV16
